{"text":"ItemID: unavailable; Title: Dust Bowl; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues-rock feels like a strong follow-up to Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels; this is my first choice.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented songwriting fits my recent listening, though I am not choosing another album now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: George Harrison; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Melodic classic rock suits my taste, but I am more interested in blues right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Endless River; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Atmospheric instrumental rock is less appealing than the song-focused music I want today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: World Famous Headliners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-rock direction sounds compatible with my interests, but it is not an immediate purchase.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Midwest Farmer's Daughter; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have some interest in country, but today I want something closer to my recent blues-rock listening.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Ride Out; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Straightforward roots rock appeals, but I would leave it for another visit.
